descriptor._caption: Then the first one lifts. A startup that walked in with a voice memo and a hunch leaves the ground, wings out, climbing. The room does not applaud politely. The room roars, because everyone in it knows exactly what that climb cost. Come on Thursday. Leave flying.

prompt: Picture-book spread painted in the warm editorial ink-and-wash register of the FIRST reference image. THE FIRST REFERENCE IMAGE IS A STYLE ANCHOR ONLY. Match it for MEDIUM, BRUSHWORK, PALETTE and LIGHT QUALITY ONLY, and take NO subject from it whatsoever: none of its objects, figures, costume, props, furniture, architecture, period or location may appear in the output unless the scene description below asks for them by name. SCENE: A FOUNDER WATCHING HER STARTUP LIFT is the subject. MAYA stands at frame LEFT in her sage-olive blazer, seen in warm three-quarter from behind-left, face turned up and away from camera in profile, laughing. Rising through the RIGHT half of the frame, the winged block-tower startup climbs into warm evening sky above the room's open window, wings spread, small and gaining height, trailing two or three soft paper-warm motion strokes. IGNORE THE SIZE AND PLACEMENT OF THE FIGURE IN THE SUPPLIED WINGED-STARTUP PLATE: here it is airborne, tilted into a climb, one-quarter the height of the frame. The room's window frame anchors the lower edge. Keep the top of the frame open sky. THE CAMERA MOVES; NOTHING ELSE DOES. Every person keeps the exact seat, side and place the setting's blocking gives them, and if a BLOCKING PLATE is supplied it is the authority on who sits where: obey it at every distance. Whatever the subject is sitting at, leaning on or standing beside is STILL IN THIS PICTURE, in the near foreground if the camera is close. Everyone else present in this place is STILL PRESENT in the picture, behind or beside the subject, soft and out of focus if they are not the subject, and NOBODY leaves and NO seat empties because the camera came closer. FRAMING, TWO-SHOT: TWO figures fill the middle of the frame from the waist up and are the subject of the picture. The camera is closer than an establishing view. Behind them the place falls away softly and out of focus, present but never competing with them. maya rendered exactly per the supplied reference images: half black half white founder; sage olive blazer single button notch lapel sleeves pushed to elbow; white crew neck tee; stone khaki chinos never blue jeans; laptop under arm; warm editorial register. MAYA: a founder, half-Black and half-white, in her sage-olive single-button notch-lapel blazer with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, plain WHITE crew-neck tee, STONE KHAKI chinos (never blue jeans, never denim trousers), white sneakers, and a closed silver laptop carried under her left arm. Earnest, capable, warm. Warm-editorial ink-and-wash, never photoreal. Master-first: the hero is the canonical calm, centered, face-on winged block-tower on plain terracotta. Every other use (the tilted climbing favicon, the hand-released cover, the soaring close) is derived as its own render with the locked hero passed as the first input image, never re-invented from prose. A render whose block-tower or wings disagree with the hero is a defect: regenerate from the master. the-room exactly as its reference plate: THE ROOM: one long working room in an ordinary building, the kind a small company grows into rather than commissions. Plain desks pushed together in irregular clusters, mismatched chairs, monitors, laptops, a whiteboard with half-erased diagrams, printouts taped to a wall, mugs, a shelf of well-used books, cables. Big plain windows down one side. No open-plan tech-campus gloss, no branding, no slogans on the walls, no neon, no glass conference boxes. The camera is INSIDE the room at standing or seated eye height, never a lobby shot and never an architectural exterior. The clusters of desks give it depth. People are ordinary in scale and are never arranged to face a leader; if anyone is speaking, the group is loose around them rather than seated in rows. The room is LIVED-IN and a little untidy, with evidence of people everywhere whether or not anyone is in frame: a jacket over a chair back, an open notebook, a half-drunk mug, printouts curling where they are taped up, mismatched chairs pushed at angles. It is NEVER sterile, NEVER a showroom, and NEVER lit dramatically; the light is only ever whatever the room actually has at that hour. RENDER EXACTLY ONE MOMENT IN TIME: one single continuous scene at one time of day, filling the whole frame. Do NOT divide the image, do NOT stack a daytime version above a night version, do NOT show the room twice, and do NOT produce a before-and-after or side-by-side comparison of any kind. One long room, human-scaled, low ceiling rather than an atrium. It should feel like somewhere about a hundred people could work, not a headquarters. THE ONLY CHARACTERS IN THIS IMAGE ARE: maya. NOBODY ELSE APPEARS. Do not add any other person, figure, creature, robot, animal or bystander, whatever the style description above may suggest. NEGATIVES: neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, glossy plastic, HUD/arc-reactor comic vocabulary, neo-comic. ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FULL-BLEED PAINTING that fills the entire canvas edge to edge. This is NEVER a grid, NEVER a multi-panel layout, NEVER a comic page, NEVER a contact sheet, NEVER a study or turnaround sheet, NEVER a collage, and NEVER several framed views side by side. Some reference images supplied to you are multi-panel study sheets; use them ONLY for the identity and design of what they depict, and NEVER copy their panelled layout into the output. The output has exactly ONE camera, ONE moment, and NO internal borders, frames, gutters, or dividing lines of any kind.
qa: winged-startup: The startup is a HAND-STACKED tower of two or three flat cream blocks, slightly imperfect and uneven, never a single block and never a neat machine-precise stack.
winged-startup: Cream wings are attached to the tower and the whole reads as LIFT: rising, climbing, or airborne, never sitting still on a surface.
winged-startup: Plate register only: flat solid terracotta ground, a single-weight wobbly confident black ink outline, flat ivory-cream fills as the only fills.
winged-startup: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, UI, or cursor marks, ever.
winged-startup: Face-on and flat: no perspective, no isometric, no parallelograms, no side faces or edge thickness, no shading, no gradients, no coloured linework.
